readScope: XML Study site, Fieldwork, Filtration, Specimen processing, Molecular assays, Reference database, Bioinformatics, Results and Discussion sections read; original supplementary detection tables, deposited reads, presence–absence matrices and scripts not independently analysed
limits: Six sites, six wet-season visits per site across 2020/2021; not a full annual inventory or independent test of single-season closure.
36 water samples collected; six with no PCR band discarded, 30 samples plus two controls sequenced; collected sample count differs from sequenced sample count.
Three litres collected per site, but filters clogged at about 1 litre for river water or 750 mL for pond water; collection volume is not filtered volume.
2020 filters processed seven months after collection versus one week after last collection in 2021; no independent analysis of preservation effects.
248 visual specimens, 195 ponds and 53 rivers; local collection counts are not density or species-wide abundance.
33 source taxa union, 28 eDNA and 20 VES, including affinity and unnamed labels; not 33 pinned accepted species.
Study site 600–710 m versus Discussion below 600 m unresolved; mountain signals not lower live-animal range extensions.
Preferred upstream DNA transport not experimentally traced; negative controls do not exclude all index errors or contamination.
Above 97% species and 90–96% genus short 16S thresholds operational, not universal taxonomic proof.
59 of 62 expected source taxa have references; three missing references do not prove absence or present-day sequence unavailability.
542 reference sequences are not 542 species; sequence reads are not individual counts, age or sex.
Terrestrial/diurnal explanations cite earlier accounts and were not new activity measurements.
Original supplements, deposited reads, detection matrices, model outputs, individual vouchers and code not independently reanalysed.
